description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Orders that No Producer, Importer, Distributor or Trader shall sell maximum retail price of imported Rice, Samba Rs. 80 per Kg, Nadu Rs. 75 per Kg, Raw Rice Rs. 65 per Kg, Order shall come into effect from 04.08.2017
reasoning: This gazette content contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum retail prices for different varieties of rice and rescinds a previous order. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
